name: vgo-client
description: A Voronoi Go board built on the Rust rules, compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p vgo-wasm --profile wasm-release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir vendor ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm-release/vgo_wasm.wasm
